Project Name: Callaway Road - Thomson Primary 500 kV
County/Region: Columbia & McDuffie counties
Type: Area Project
About the Project: Georgia Power is planning the Callaway Road – Thomson Primary 500 kV Area Transmission Project. The project will include a new 500/230 kV Callaway Road Substation, approximately 17 miles of new 500 kV transmission infrastructure, and associated facilities in McDuffie and Columbia Counties. The project is being planned to provide the transmission infrastructure needed to serve a large-load customer while also strengthening the local electric grid in a rapidly growing area. These improvements are expected to add capacity, enhance reliability for homes and businesses, and help support continued growth and evolving energy needs. As planning progresses, project details will continue to be refined based on engineering, environmental, and routing studies.
What's Included: Certain project components are designed to serve the large load customer site, while all improvements contribute to strengthening the overall transmission system. Callaway Road Substation : Construction of a new substation in Columbia County to support both 500 kV and 230 kV transmission infrastructure. Callaway Road–Thomson #1 500 kV Transmission Line : Approximately 10 miles of new 500 kV transmission line in McDuffie and Columbia counties. This project is part of Georgia Power’s ongoing commitment to strengthen and expand the electric grid. By replacing aging infrastructure with more modern materials and design, the project will enhance system reliability, support Georgia’s evolving energy needs, and help ensure safe, resilient electric service for decades to come.

Project Name: Hills Bridge – Speedway 500/230 kV
County/Region: Clayton & Henry counties
Type: New Transmission Line
About the Project: Georgia Power is planning the Hills Bridge–Speedway 500 kV Transmission Project in Henry and Clayton counties to support the electric needs of a data center customer that requires new transmission infrastructure, while also strengthening the local electric grid in a rapidly growing area. The project currently includes construction of three transmission lines, one 500 kV line and two 230 kV lines, as well as two new substations, Hills Bridge 500/230 kV Substation and Speedway 230 kV Substation. Together, these improvements will add capacity, enhance reliability for homes and businesses, and position the region to support continued growth and evolving energy needs.
What's Included: Certain components of the project are being evaluated to support customer-specific needs, while all improvements contribute to strengthening the overall transmission system. Some elements are in the planning phase, and details may be refined as the project progresses. Hills Bridge 500/230 kV Substation: Construction of a new substation in Clayton County to support both 500 kV and 230 kV transmission infrastructure. Speedway 230 kV Substation: Construction of a new substation in Henry County that will serve this new data customer on the customer’s property. O’Hara–Scherer 500 kV Transmission Line (Hills Bridge Loop): Approximately .25 mile of new 500 kV transmission line in Clayton County connecting the new substation to existing transmission facilities. Hills Bridge–Speedway #1 230 kV Transmission Line: Approximately 1.5 miles of new 230 kV transmission line in Henry and Clayton counties. Hills Bridge–Speedway #2 230 kV Transmission Line: Approximately 1.0 mile of new 230 kV transmission line connecting nearby substations and operating alongside other new facilities. the electric grid with added transmission capacity. large-load demands while reinforcing local system. for growing energy needs in Georgia
